title: dont use modals for complex forms
name: Don't use modals for complex forms
rule: Don’t use modals for complex forms or large information; max two bottom actions; tertiary never dismisses.
pass_when: Complex forms / large information are not in a modal; modal has at most two bottom actions; a tertiary action does not dismiss.
fail_when: Complex form or large information in a modal; more than two bottom actions; tertiary dismisses.
overview: Keep complex forms out of modals; max two bottom actions; tertiary never dismisses.
apply_when: Deciding whether a form or large content belongs in a modal.
not_when: Complex forms in modals, more than two bottom actions, or tertiary dismiss.
agent_hint: Keep complex forms out of modals; limit to two bottom actions; tertiary never dismisses.
description: Don’t use modals for complex forms or large information; max two bottom actions; tertiary never dismisses. Pass when complex forms or large information are not in a modal, the modal has at most two bottom actions, and a tertiary action does not dismiss. Fail when a complex form or large information is in a modal, there are more than two bottom actions, or tertiary dismisses.
do_not_claim: NN/g modal 7-list as a merge; `actions.button_groups` “three or four”. Overlap with Actions 40: `button_groups` / confirm.
